title: Rohan gets paid $5,000. Watch where it goes 💸
description:
$5,000 a month sounds like a lot, so where does it all go?
Assumed shares of a $5,000 month (tax, rent, car, food, fun) and what the small leftover becomes at an assumed 7% a year over 30 years, computed. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
